body:
# 🏕️ Scouts Rupelmonde SMP – Performance Modpack

This modpack is built specifically for the Scouts Rupelmonde SMP, designed to deliver a smooth, stable, and lag-free Minecraft experience. Whether you're exploring, building, or adventuring with your patrol, this pack maximizes performance while keeping gameplay fully vanilla-friendly.

It contains a curated set of client-side performance mods, ensuring high FPS, faster loading, improved responsiveness, and zero unfair advantages on the server.

## ✨ Features

**🚀 Significant FPS boosts from core optimization mods**
**🧹 Reduced stuttering & smoother memory usage**
**🌍 Optimized chunk loading for exploration-heavy gameplay**
**🔧 Lightweight, stable, and server-friendly**
**🎮 No gameplay changes — purely performance-focused**

## 📦 What’s Inside

A hand-picked collection of performance mods, including:
- Rendering and engine optimizers
- Chunk and world-loading improvements
- UI and quality-of-life enhancements
- Various fixes for lag spikes and micro-stutters

All mods remain fully vanilla-compatible and safe to use on the **Scouts Rupelmonde SMP**.
